history.body: Hi, I work around Perai and saw your Seberang Jaya ad. Is this location convenient for daily travel?

Seberang Jaya is on the Penang Mainland, with connections toward Butterworth and the wider mainland urban network, so it could be convenient for getting around Perai. Exact travel time depends on your route and traffic. Are you looking for your own stay or investment?
Own stay, first place. I’m still figuring out what’s manageable.
For a first home, the Type A offers 900 sq. ft., 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony—seeing the layout may help you judge what feels manageable. Would weekdays or weekends suit you for a viewing?
Maybe later. I’d like to know the price and monthly costs first, then I can see if a viewing makes sense.

An indicative starting reference is about RM302k after the package for an eligible Block 1B podium-blocked category, before unit-specific parking or add-ons. For the 900 sq. ft. Type A, maintenance at RM0.18 per sq. ft. works out to about RM162/month, inclusive of the sinking fund; utilities and other costs are separate. Would a viewing help you judge the layout and overall fit—weekdays or weekends?
